files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: config_list_integrations
tool_schemas.description: Lists configured integrations and returns the matching integration records, optionally filtered by integration type and/or enabled state. Requests are refused when the provided type is not a supported integration type or when enabled is not a boolean value. If filters are provided, only integrations that satisfy all filters are returned.

tool_schemas.name: config_get_integration
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the integration record for the given integration_id. The request is refused when integration_id is missing or empty. If no integration exists with that id, the response indicates it was not found rather than returning an integration.

tool_schemas.name: config_update_integration
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing integration’s configuration by changing its enabled flag and/or webhook URL, and returns the updated integration record. The request is refused when integration_id is missing, when no updatable fields are provided, when the integration does not exist, or when the webhook value is not a valid URL string. Updates are also refused if the integration is in a state that does not allow modification.

tool_schemas.name: config_send_notification
tool_schemas.description: Routes and sends a notification using the specified integration and returns a delivery attempt result for that notification. The request is refused when integration_id or message is missing/empty, when level is provided but is not one of the supported values, when the integration does not exist, or when the integration is disabled. Requests are also refused when the integration lacks the required routing configuration (for example, no webhook is set) to deliver the notification.

metadata.name: HarborLink Integration Router
metadata.description: Centralizes configuration of external integrations and routes operational notifications to the right endpoints for each team.
